data.theorem_title: For $0\le s\le1$, the Zipf harmonic sums tend to infinity
data.formal_statement:
namespace ZipfLaw

theorem zipf_genHarmonic_tendsto_atTop (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => genHarmonic N s) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop := by sorry

end ZipfLaw
data.natural_language_statement: For every real exponent $0\le s\le1$, the generalized harmonic sums $H_{N,s}$ tend to $+\infty$ as $N\to\infty$. In particular no finite normalizing constant can extend these finite Zipf laws to infinitely many ranks.
data.source: Wikipedia, "Zipf's law", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zipf%27s_law, section "Formal definition"; auxiliary lemma for the original ZipfLaw mission, derived from its displayed PMF and generalized harmonic sum.
